items.name: Maiden
items.keyQualities: Fresh perception, experimentation, and the courage to make a first choice.

items.name: Lover
items.keyQualities: The Lover stage includes a generative current: eros becomes relationship, art, healing, and form.

items.name: Mother
items.keyQualities: Care that feeds growth, guards what is vulnerable, and strengthens autonomy.

items.name: Queen
items.keyQualities: Clear rule, proportionate judgment, and visible leadership that enlarges others.

items.name: Crone
items.keyQualities: Truth beyond approval, reverence for cycles, and service free of the need to be central.

items.keyQualities: Wise, Discerning, Curious, Strategic, Calm, Perceptive, Measured, Ethical, Insightful, Practical

items.name: Storyteller
items.keyQualities: Meaningful, Vivid, Source-aware, Contextual, Memorable, Consent-aware, Precise, Integrative, Correctable, Transmissible

items.name: Reckless Wanderer
items.keyQualities: Creates preventable emergencies, Breaks agreements for novelty, Uses motion to avoid feeling

items.name: Sheltered Dreamer
items.keyQualities: Plans without departure, Overstates unlikely dangers, Lives through others' courage

items.name: Naive Enthusiast
items.keyQualities: Commits before understanding, Idealizes unfamiliar people, Leaves consequences to others

items.name: Frozen Beginner
items.keyQualities: Research replaces participation, Defers ordinary choices, Dismisses curiosity as childish

items.name: Inflated Oracle
items.keyQualities: Speaks uncertain futures as facts, Claims special access to truth, Reframes disagreement as spiritual failure

items.name: Self-Doubting Seer
items.keyQualities: Edits insight out of speech, Outsources inner authority, Waits for impossible proof

items.name: Compulsive Perfecter
items.keyQualities: Reworks settled details, Confuses polish with value, Never exposes work to use, Edits herself before creating, Imitates the prevailing taste, Waits indefinitely for permission

items.name: Scattered Maker
items.keyQualities: Accumulates unfinished projects, Changes direction at ordinary friction, Depends on mood to work, Broadcasts unfinished impulses, Abandons work after the first excitement, Overruns collaborators

items.name: Enmeshing Lover
items.keyQualities: Accelerates intimacy and treats a pause as rejection, Volunteers at work and reads limits as disloyalty, Rehearses another person's mood before naming her own, Overrides hunger, fatigue, pain, or reluctance to stay pleasing, Uses gifts, sex, service, or crisis to obtain reassurance indirectly, Shrinks friendships, projects, and privacy around one bond

items.name: Armored Lover
items.keyQualities: Keeps intimacy articulate but emotionally negotiated, Turns tenderness into analysis, humor, or sexual performance, Leaves when another person matters enough to disappoint her, Receives admiration while concealing ordinary need, Treats help as debt and influence as loss of rank, Holds the body composed when grief or affection asks it to soften

items.name: Rescuing Healer
items.keyQualities: Gives unsolicited treatment, Takes responsibility for outcomes, Ignores fatigue and scope

items.name: Guarded Healer
items.keyQualities: Uses policy to avoid contact, Withdraws at visible need, Confuses non-rescue with non-care

items.name: Controlling Sentinel
items.keyQualities: Polices ordinary choices, Moves boundaries without consent, Cannot stand down after safety returns

items.name: Open Gate
items.keyQualities: Ignores repeated breaches, Delegates safety to hope, Avoids necessary exclusion

items.name: Engulfing Mother
items.keyQualities: Solves before being asked, Treats separation as disloyalty, Undermines others' competence

items.name: Unavailable Mother
items.keyQualities: Minimizes legitimate dependency, Withdraws during distress, Provides freedom without support

items.name: Peace Enforcer
items.keyQualities: Rushes forgiveness, Neutralizes legitimate anger, Equates calm with safety

items.name: Resentful Bystander
items.keyQualities: Withholds grievances, Punishes through distance, Waits for mind-reading

items.name: Rampaging Warrior
items.keyQualities: Escalates after the threat ends, Dehumanizes opponents, Treats intensity as moral proof

items.name: Disarmed Warrior
items.keyQualities: Freezes under violation, Apologizes for firm limits, Abandons aims at resistance

items.name: Enmeshing Networker
items.keyQualities: Triangulates through private information, Protects insiders from consequence, Makes herself the relational hub

items.name: Isolated Helper
items.keyQualities: Serves without receiving, Leaves at ordinary conflict, Uses critique to remain outside

items.name: Martyr Host
items.keyQualities: Overfunctions and keeps score, Makes unspoken sacrifices, Treats privacy as selfishness

items.name: Closed Hearth
items.keyQualities: Makes belonging conditional on tidiness, Withholds ordinary welcome, Uses the home to avoid relationship

items.name: Merciless Judge
items.keyQualities: Globalizes a single failure, Punishes beyond protection, Uses exposure as moral theater

items.name: Permissive Witness
items.keyQualities: Excuses repeated harm, Centers intent over impact, Offers forgiveness without change

items.name: Tyrannical Queen
items.keyQualities: Hoards decisions, Rewards personal loyalty, Confuses obedience with alignment

items.name: Abdicating Queen
items.keyQualities: Defers necessary decisions, Lets informal power dominate, Apologizes for role authority

items.name: Blinding Star
items.keyQualities: Redirects attention to herself, Treats admiration as agreement, Competes with emerging voices

items.name: Hidden Light
items.keyQualities: Declines appropriate recognition, Hides expertise, Apologizes for impact

items.name: Manipulative Sorceress
items.keyQualities: Treats capability as authorization, Bypasses consent to preserve momentum, Hides means, risks, or tradeoffs, Defines the end without affected parties, Dismisses feedback that challenges the intervention, Counts compliance as evidence of benefit

items.name: Powerless Mystic
items.keyQualities: Requires certainty before a bounded intervention, Treats limited jurisdiction as no jurisdiction, Expands ethical review without a decision point, Uses possible harm to excuse ongoing inaction, Calls nonintervention principled despite consequences, Transfers responsibility while continuing to object

items.name: Scorched-Earth Crone
items.keyQualities: Uses total severance as first response, Rewrites the past as worthless, Destroys supports needed for transition

items.name: Relic Keeper
items.keyQualities: Keeps expired commitments, Organizes identity around loss, Resists new life as betrayal

items.name: Martyred Healer
items.keyQualities: Cannot conclude care, Makes outcomes personal, Sacrifices health to preserve a healer identity

items.name: Cynical Healer
items.keyQualities: Reduces people to diagnoses, Withholds warmth as realism, Uses experience to foreclose possibility

items.name: Premature Oracle
items.keyQualities: Predicts instead of listening, Overloads people with distant implications, Uses mystery to claim authority

items.name: Withholding Seer
items.keyQualities: Speaks only after outcomes are obvious, Hides clarity behind riddles, Confuses noninterference with wisdom

items.name: Chaotic Rebel
items.keyQualities: Breaks alliances for purity, Escalates without strategy, Leaves others to absorb fallout

items.name: Compliant Critic
items.keyQualities: Complains without organizing, Waits for moral certainty, Complies publicly and rebels privately

items.name: Arrogant Know-It-All
items.keyQualities: Oversteps boundaries; decides for others, Mistakes speed for effectiveness, Performs care or genius to avoid vulnerability, Micromanages; cannot rest, Seeks admiration or control over connection, Ignores feedback, doubles down under stress

items.name: Withholding Sage
items.keyQualities: Defers decisions; waits for perfect certainty, Disengages from body and relationships, People-pleases to avoid conflict, Lets others set terms then resents them, Creativity stalled by perfectionism and fear, Self-doubt presented as humility

items.name: Exaggerating Dramatist
items.keyQualities: Adds connective detail that was not remembered, Turns inference into stated fact, Removes uncertainty to strengthen the arc, Centers the narrator in another person's account, Shares entrusted material without sufficient consent, Protects a compelling version from correction

items.name: Silent Keeper
items.keyQualities: Requires exhaustive certainty before telling, Treats every finite selection as betrayal, Archives entrusted experience without transmission, Confuses privacy with a ban on responsible redaction, Preserves so much context that meaning cannot travel, Calls silence Fidelity despite the loss of memory
